text:
ajay: Hey team — Orchid Labs just signed up and we ran the auto-provisioner. Customer reports no API key appears in their project console. I can see a token in the DB but 403 when they call our API.

lina_g: Can you paste the error they get?

ajay: They did a quick curl: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/models
# -> {\n  \"error\": \"permission_denied\",\n  \"message\": \"API key not scoped to project\"\n}
```

maya_h: Ugh, that looks like the token exists but is bound to the root org / test-project instead of their customer project. We saw this once with a race in the provisioner where the service-role binding step failed.

ajay: I checked the provisioner logs: 
```
2026-03-17T12:34:11Z provisioner: created token id=tok_9a8b
2026-03-17T12:34:12Z provisioner: bind-service-role failed tenant=orchid-labs status=403 msg=rolebinding not found
2026-03-17T12:34:13Z provisioner: marked token as created, claim=staged
```

lina_g: @infra_ops can you confirm whether claim-sync job retried? Might have been a transient IAM propagation issue.

infra_ops: Looking... I see a duplicate service account for orchid-labs created earlier for a sandbox test. The provisioner tried binding to the canonical SA but the internal matcher returned the older SA id so the binding failed and token landed unscoped.

support_bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0317-ORCHID-1, tagging provisioner and iam teams.

ajay: Ok, next steps? Customer is blocked in prod. They requested a repro and a fix.

maya_h: Short-term fix: rebind the token to their project manually and rotate. I can run the rebind script if infra approves. Long-term: add an idempotent check in provisioner to avoid matching on display_name only.

infra_ops: I can do the rebind now. Command I will run: 
```
rbac rebind-key --token tok_9a8b --tenant orchid-labs --force --rotate
```

lina_g: Please capture logs and return the new token to Ajay in DM, don't post keys here. Also leave a comment in the provisioner PR for the matcher fix.

infra_ops: Rebind done. Rotated token returned to Ajay via DM. Verified calls now succeed: 
```
# from customer test env
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_NEW\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health
# -> {\n  \"ok\": true\n}
```

ajay: Confirmed with Orchid Labs. They can make calls and can see the key in their console project UI now. :tada:

maya_h: Filing a follow-up ticket to update provisioner to match by canonical SA id and to retry the bind step 3 times with backoff. Also add a monitoring alert for tokens created without bindings.

support_bot: Follow-up task created: TASK-PLT-9872 (provisioner idempotency + token-binding alert).

lina_g: Thanks everyone. I'll send a customer-facing write-up to Orchid Labs explaining root cause, mitigation, and timeline for permanent fix.

ajay: Closing loop with the customer now. If infra needs anything else please leave notes on INC-2026-0317-ORCHID-1.

infra_ops: adding logs & timeline to the incident. Noted: avoid rotating tokens live during rebind until revoke is validated.

maya_h: Good call. I'll also add a runbook step for oncall to follow when provisioner creates orphaned tokens.

ajay: Thanks all — closing thread after customer confirms billing and console visibility.
